title: SearchGPT streams get their own cache entries
summary:
Two fixes made SearchGPT streaming and image option handling more predictable.

The text API now includes `stream` in its cache key, so a streaming SearchGPT request cannot receive a cached non-streaming response.

Image parameter sanitization now treats malformed values as false for `enhance`, `nologo`, `nofeed`, and `private`. Feed events consequently receive boolean `enhance` values.
